diagnoses.analysis: This is the aggregate required-status gate, not an independent source failure. reusable-pr-build.yml:62-89 requires both test-latest-deps and muzzle to succeed and exits 1 when either fails. The other two frozen failed checks identify those exact prerequisites. The two candidate commits fix their PR-attributable causes; no workflow change is warranted.

The PR introduces nested Routes.runZIO calls. In pinned latest ZIO HTTP 3.11.6, runZIO requires Scope; this requirement leaks into the installed routes and Server.install rejects it via HasNoScope. Commit 2 scopes every delegated runZIO execution, keeping each route environment scope-free and closing its local resources. Both route suites pass against baseline 3.0.0 and latest 3.11.6, eight tests per suite per version.
evidence: ZioHttpTestApplication.scala:123:13: The type <refinement> contains a zio.Scope. This is not allowed.

diagnoses.analysis: The new completion finalizer calls ZIO$.succeed(Function0,Object), which is a Scala 2 JVM signature. Scala 3 exposes a different succeed signature. Commit 1 uses the common succeedUnsafe(Function1<Unsafe,A>,Object) entry point, preserving lazy completion-time enrichment and success/typed-failure filtering without performing unsafe operations. Six explicit Muzzle acceptance assertions pass for ZIO HTTP 3.0.0 and 3.11.6 on Scala 2.12, 2.13 and 3. The original broad muzzle command did not execute assertions because Aether could not access remote metadata; explicit endpoint directives and a temporary repository override were used for meaningful compatibility checks.

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

Fix ZIO HTTP route enrichment after handlers yield, including when runtime context propagation is disabled:

```properties
otel.instrumentation.zio-2.0.enabled=false
otel.instrumentation.zio-http.enabled=true
```

Completion-time enrichment preserves the innermost route when handlers delegate, including nested delegation.

Split from #20834. This PR targets `main` and does not depend on the runtime changes.
